SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) AS cc_sales_gross,
  SUM(wo.order_total_gross) AS total_web_sales_gross,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN 1 END) AS cc_orders,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) / 
        SUM(wo.order_total_gross), 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  w.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_period_label,
  fully_loaded,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT MAX(sale_date) as max_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    w.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
  WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type
)
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(
    (SELECT net_sales FROM period_sales ps2 
     WHERE ps2.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year 
     AND ps2.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period 
     AND ps2.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect'),
    0
  ) / NULLIF(
    (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM period_sales ps3 
     WHERE ps3.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year 
     AND ps3.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period),
    0
  ), 1) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar d
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
